tasks.title: First earnings call dry run
tasks.description: IR scripts the CFO, legal vets every forward-looking adjective, and you practice saying “no comment” politely.

tasks.title: Quiet period compliance training
tasks.description: Every exec watches the video — especially the one who live-tweets.

tasks.title: Shelf registration refresh
tasks.description: Counsel updates the S-3 so a secondary or ATM program is ready when the window opens.

tasks.title: Index inclusion roadshow
tasks.description: Meet the index committees — float, liquidity, and free-float math on every slide.

tasks.title: 10b5-1 plan rollout
tasks.description: Officers adopt trading plans so sales do not look like panic every time the stock dips.

tasks.title: Annual shareholder letter
tasks.description: Founder letter that reads human, cites real metrics, and survives the footnote audit.

tasks.title: SOX control testing sprint
tasks.description: Auditors sample controls; you fix the three gaps before they write the deficiency paragraph.

tasks.title: Short report response war room
tasks.description: Fact-check the deck, publish a rebuttal, and keep the board off CNBC unless counsel says yes.

tasks.title: Analyst day breakout sessions
tasks.description: Product, finance, and GTM deep dives — models updated before the after-market drift.

tasks.title: Buyback authorization announcement
tasks.description: Board approves a repurchase program; IR drafts the release and the chart goes green for a day.

tasks.title: Proxy season Glass Lewis tour
tasks.description: Explain say-on-pay, board refresh, and why the comp table is “market aligned.”

tasks.title: 8-K material contract filing
tasks.description: Sign the whale deal, drop the 8-K after close, and hope the headline parser gets the number right.

tasks.title: Retail shareholder earnings AMA
tasks.description: Hosted Q&A on the investor site — moderators delete the meme questions, mostly.

tasks.title: Dual listing feasibility study
tasks.description: Bankers model London or Hong Kong — liquidity, timing, and whether you need another roadshow.

tasks.title: Lockup expiry communications plan
tasks.description: Coordinate selling stockholders, file the S-8s, and keep the volume explainable on day 180.

tasks.title: ESG rating upgrade push
tasks.description: Submit the questionnaire, close the data gaps, and chase MSCI before fund mandates rebalance.
